description: This file defines the LocationService class, which manages location updates and authorization using CoreLocation. It provides methods for fetching current location, starting/stopping location updates, monitoring significant location changes, and handling authorization status changes.

classes.name: LocationService
classes.description: A final class managing location services, including requesting permissions, receiving location updates, and handling significant location change monitoring.

methods.name: ensureAuthorization
methods.description: Asynchronously requests and ensures the app has the specified location authorization mode (e.g., 'When In Use' or 'Always').

methods.name: currentLocation
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current location with specified parameters, utilizing a request method with timeout handling.

methods.name: startLocationUpdates
methods.description: Starts location updates with the desired accuracy and returns an async stream of CLLocation updates.

methods.name: stopLocationUpdates
methods.description: Stops ongoing location updates and monitoring.

methods.name: startMonitoringSignificantLocationChanges
methods.description: Begins monitoring significant location changes, invoking a callback upon updates.
